description:
Lunar Squirrel, located in Aberdeen, MD, distinguishes itself through a product range of nostalgia inspired products, toys, novelties, candy, products useful to craftsmen, sportsmen, and hobbyists and handmade items. We offer services such as e-commerce website development, 3D designs and printing, electronics repair, and customized jewelry and weaved items. With a thriving retail shop, the business is poised for growth. The brand's mission to provide a break from the constantly connected lifestyle sets it apart, while a commitment to community engagement, sustainability, and continuous market research ensures its enduring success.

1. Commission Structure:

  • Affiliates will earn a commission of 10% on all sales generated through their unique affiliate links.

2. Payment Schedule:

  • Commissions will be paid monthly, within 15 days after the end of each calendar month, provided the affiliate has reached a minimum balance of $100.

3. Payment Method:

  • Payments will be made via PayPal to the email address provided by the affiliate. Bank transfer is available upon request, subject to applicable fees.

4. Cookie Duration:

  • The cookie duration is 30 days. Affiliates will receive commissions on sales made within 30 days of a user clicking their affiliate link.

5. Returns and Chargebacks:

  • Commissions will be reversed for returned products or chargebacks initiated within 30 days of purchase.

6. Termination:

  • Either party may terminate the affiliate agreement with 30 days’ notice. Upon termination, any pending commissions will be paid out in the next scheduled payment cycle.

7. Promotional Guidelines:

  • Affiliates must adhere to our brand guidelines and refrain from engaging in unethical or misleading promotional practices.

8. Reporting:

  • Affiliates will receive a monthly performance report detailing sales, commissions earned, and any adjustments (e.g., returns, chargebacks).

9. Non-Disclosure and Confidentiality:

  • Affiliates agree to maintain the confidentiality of any proprietary information shared by the company during the term of this agreement.

10. Dispute Resolution:

  • Any disputes regarding commission payments or other matters will be resolved through negotiation in good faith. If necessary, mediation or arbitration may be pursued in accordance with US laws.
